extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology record rebuilt from Results, Methods, tables, and figure captions; pending-review scaffold notes were replaced with bounded direct/inferred claims.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: t-DPH1 and selected analogues directly permeabilised S. aureus and E. coli membranes in the SYTOX Green assay, with t-DPH1-K4 and t-DPH1-5K showing strong concentration-linked effects.
direct_assay_types: SYTOX Green bacterial cell membrane permeabilisation assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-level percentages beyond the narrative thresholds are not tabulated in local text; claim is limited to membrane permeabilisation direction and assay type.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-kill assays support bactericidal kinetics for t-DPH1, t-DPH1-K4, t-DPH1-5K and t-DPH1-6K against E. coli and S. aureus at source-defined MIC multiples.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Kinetic curves are figure-only in local material; exact CFU values are not converted into row-level activity records.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Serial passage testing did not show increased E. coli MICs for t-DPH1, t-DPH1-K4, t-DPH1-5K and t-DPH1-6K over 12 cycles.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: t-DPH1, t-DPH1-K4, t-DPH1-5K, t-DPH1-6K against E. coli ATCC 8739
mechanism_claims.limitations: The figure supports stable MIC trend; exact cycle-by-cycle MIC table is not available in local text.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The structure-function conclusion is bounded: increasing cationicity improved some antimicrobial and antiproliferative endpoints up to a threshold, while excess charge or hydrophobic change did not uniformly improve activity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is an inference from source tables and discussion, not a direct molecular mechanism assay.
